section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1987
title: 8 ## Metropolitan Cities : 1.4.3 The incidence of accidental deaths recorded a decline of 8.3% in 1987 over 1986 in the 12 Metropolitan Cities as a whole out of which 4 registered an increase in the total number of accidental deaths during 1987 over 1986. Other 8 Cities registered a decline in the total number of accidental deaths during 1987 over 1986.
